offline_scope: fixed recorded command and posterior-output replay; no counterfactual RGB/PF/map or physical task success
admission: fewer >20cm control jumps and pooled map XY RMSE <= baseline; per-run regression disclosed; select at most two non-off settings plus off = 18 runs
online: fresh same-seed B/return paired DEV because checkpoint prefix admission is missing in egomap71; not identical resumed egomap70 cohort
storage: peak 768 MiB per run plus source and archive temporary reserves; Mac fetch-lite 5MiB/run; bound finite concurrency to actual free disk
initial_check: at 180-240 wall seconds: exceptions, frames/SIM, evaluation-only displacement, command diversity and stage entry; abnormal own run SIGINT and EXIT
